decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Subject to the completion of a Section 106 Deed, and appropriate safeguarding
conditions, it is considered that these proposals, because of their position,
design and appearance, would be acceptable, having due regard for the site
characteristics of these unused Listed and locally listed buildings and would not
be detrimental to the appearance of the Listed building and locally listed building,
their ancillary/curtilage structures, the character and appearance of the
surrounding area and setting of the Thames, pedestrian and highway safety, or
neighbours living conditions and would provide a suitable standard of
accommodation for future residents.
31
The development is therefore in accordance with the UDP Policies ENV- B.1.1
(New Development), C.1.1 (Existing religious meeting places), C.1.3 (Existing
community and social Facilities) ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and
Buildings of Local Townscape Character), ENV-B.2.3 (Reuse of redundant
historic buildings), H.4.1 (Housing standards and guidelines), H.4.4 (Provision for
Children?s Play in Housing Developments), T.1.2 (The movement implications of
development), T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for
developments), T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development), T.4.4 (Road
Safety), ENV-W.1.1 (Design in the Thames Policy Area), ENV-W.1.3 (Important
Views and Structures in the Thames Policy Area), ENV-B.2.8 (Views and
landmarks), ENV.B.1.9 (Safety and Security), Supplementary Planning
Guidance, the Employment DPD and Brentford Area Action Plan; and London
Plan policies 3A.1 (Increasing London?s supply of housing), 3D.13 (Children and
young people?s play and informal recreation strategies, 4A.3 (Sustainable Design
and Construction), 4B.8 (Respect local context and communities), 4B.11
(London?s Built Heritage), 4B.12 (Heritage conservation), 4C.17 (Thames Policy
Area), 2A.1 (Sustainability Criteria) and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the
building, or its ancillary or curtilage structures, or the removal of any internal
feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and
restoration hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the
existing structures as specifically shown on the approved drawings

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of the development a description of the steps and
works to be taken and carried out in relation to the repair and alteration of the
existing timber frame of the buildings, including any additional elements to be
inserted, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in
writing and the development shall thereafter be undertaken in accordance with
the approved scheme

Condition : 6 - Any areas of external brickwork/masonry required to be created/replaced in
accordance with the approved plans shall match the existing brickwork /
masonry in colour and size, mortar colour and pointing and bonding detail.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the dwellings hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 8 - The Sarah Trimmer Hall Sign and any associated features shall
be retained except where otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning
Authority.
description: Conversion of former St Georges Church and Sarah Trimmer Hall (Grade II Listed Building) to 14 residential units, consisting of 9 townhouses, 4 flats and 1 maisonette. The proposal will involve partial demolition of the church (inc removal of chimney & stack and opening up the external walls) and demolition of the kitchen extension to Sarah Trimmer Hall
